profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer 🧑🏽‍💻, Strategist 📊, and Product Designer 📱

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Healthcare-focused Analyst within the Strategic Innovation Group

positions.title: Design Team Member - Novel Spirometry System
positions.description:
● Worked in a team setting to design a novel diagnostic spirometry system in order to help alleviate the burden of chronic obstructive lung disease in the developing world
● Partnered with Professors from the JHU Biomedical Engineering Department, Doctors from the Johns Hopkins Hospital, and clinicians in India to test the prototype in both rural India and Uganda on over 1,600 patients
● Won various awards and prize money of over $10,000 for our concept and business plan

positions.title: Design Team Member - Neonatal Resuscitation
positions.locationName: Johns Hopkins University Center for Bioengineering Innovation & Design
positions.description:
● Worked in a team setting to further design and development of a prototype to treat neonatal resuscitation in developing countries.
● Analyzed MRI data for an approved IRB study for the device; traveled to national competitions to communicate research results and prototype design to medical experts; augmented device design based on preliminary stakeholder feedback and Pediatrician input.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
● Developed a basic android based mHealth application to aid in diagnosing chronic wounds in patients.
● Coordinated discussions with the CTO and CEO to communicate the design and development process.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
● Performed wet—lab techniques including: gel electrophoresis, western blotting, PCR, qPCR, microarray assays, and confocal immunofluorescence to characterize promoter polymorphisms associated with X-linked mental retardation.
● Cross-analyzed genomic data in Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) in order to identify single—nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) related to cardiac diseases; correlated trends in this data with statistical analysis in R.

educations.schoolName: The Woodlands College Park Academy of Science & Technology

honors.title: 1st Place at Johns Hopkins Business Plan Competition (MedTech Division)
honors.description: ● Presented a $10,000 award by judges from the Medical and Venture Capital industries for pitching a novel, low-cost spirometer prototype.
honors.issuer: Issued by Johns Hopkins University Center for Leadership Education · May 2015

honors.title: Finalist at Carnegie Mellon University Venture Challenge
honors.description:
● Named one of 12 finalists out of a pool of over 70 applicants for a business designed around a novel, low-cost spriometer
● Invited to Pittsburgh to pitch to judges from the Venture Capital Industry
honors.issuer: Issued by Carnegie Mellon University Venture Challenge Competition · Apr 2015

volunteerExperiences.description:
● The Johns Hopkins Tutorial Project is an after-school tutoring program that provides academic support for elementary school students in the Baltimore area.
    ● Responsible for performing assessments and interviewing children.
    ● Responsible for monitoring progress of tutor-tutee pairs.
    ● Responsible for maintaining contact with tutors and fostering tutor-tutee relationships.

publications.title: Defining Optimal Head-Tilt Position of Resuscitation in Neonates and Young Infants Using Magnetic Resonance Imaging Data
Assessment of upper airway patency in spontaneously breathing non-intubated neonates and infants undergoing conventional MRI of head and neck

organizations.name: Center for Social Concern Student Advocacy Board
organizations.position: Group Management Committee, Public Relations Committee · Apr 2013 - May 2015
organizations.description:
● Managed over 70 CSC affiliated organizations in regards to program activity, funding, member recruitment and volunteer retention. 
● Innovated the public relations committee by planning 4 unprecedented on—campus events attended by over 500 students and launching a new logo and volunteer—hour recognition program; coordinated project sites for 1,000+ volunteers for President’s Day of Service.

organizations.name: Johns Hopkins Business and Consulting Club
organizations.position: Executive Officer, Undergraduate Liason · May 2014 - May 2015
organizations.description:
● Served as the only Undergraduate Executive Officer.
● Planned and coordinated details for large events and bi—weekly case reviews.
● Organized and participated in competitive case competitions; coordinated industry speakers for large Bootcamps and events.
